requirements:
Build a food delivery platform that supports 50,000 concurrent users. 
Users should be able to browse restaurants, search menus, place orders, 
make secure payments, and track delivery drivers in real time. 
The system should have high availability, low latency, strong security, 
and should automatically scale during peak hours. Order processing and 
notifications should support asynchronous communication.
constraints_text:
Keep infrastructure cost reasonable. Use PostgreSQL for transactional 
data, Redis for caching and real-time data, and a message broker for 
asynchronous order processing. The system should support horizontal 
scaling and secure payment processing.
